order_warnings: rule organization: branches 1 and 2 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule organization: branches 1 and 3 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule organization: branches 2 and 3 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule organization: branches 5 and 6 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)
rule identifier: branches 1 and 2 are order-dependent (shared first bytes; ordered choice is decisive)

source:
# Port of lib/pubid/ansi/parser.rb: ANSI [copublishers] [Std] number
# [:year][(languages)]. The number alternatives cover letter-prefixed
# forms (C37.06.1, N323A) and plain dotted forms (802.1b-1995).
#
# Edition-2 notes: letter_head_part / plain_part / year_digits bodies are
# inlined at the capture sites (a capture wrapping a rule ref expands to
# element hashes, while the inlined body binds as one scalar string).
# The copublishers wrapper stays a capture so the tree keeps the
# {copublishers: [...]} shape the builder reads; the repeats collect by
# occurrence under copublishers[].copublisher.

grammar PubidAnsi version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  organization = "ISO" / "IEC" / "IEEE" / "SAE" / "ASME" / "ASTM"
  # The copublisher body is inlined to raw terms: bare rule refs next to
  # a capture drop the capture or materialize stray {slash:} nodes.
  copublisher_item = "/" [" "] ( "ISO" / "IEC" / "IEEE" / "SAE" / "ASME" / "ASTM" ) as copublisher
  copublishers = ( 1*copublisher_item ) as copublishers
  std_keyword = ["Std "]
  number_with_part = {
    (
      ( 1*(%x41-5A) 1*(%x30-39) *3("." 1*(%x30-39)) [*1(%x41-5A)] [("-" 1*(%x30-39))] )
      / ( 1*(%x30-39) *2("." 1*(%x30-39) [*1(%x61-7A)]) [("-" 1*(%x30-39))] )
    ) as number_with_part
  }
  date = ":" ( ("19" / "20") 2*(%x30-39) !(%x30-39) ) as date
  languages = ( *( 2*(%x61-7A) [","] ) ) as languages
  language = "(" languages ")"
  identifier_with_copublishers = {
    "ANSI" as publisher copublishers " " ["Std "] number_with_part [date] [language]
  }
  identifier_sole = {
    "ANSI" as publisher " " ["Std "] number_with_part [date] [language]
  }
  identifier = identifier_with_copublishers / identifier_sole
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  digit = %x30-39
  dot = "."
  dash = "-"
  colon = ":"
  slash = "/"
  space = " "
  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    publisher -> publisher (string)
    copublisher -> copublishers[].copublisher (string)
    number_with_part -> number_with_part (string)
    date -> date (string)
    languages -> languages (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "ANSI C63.4"
    accept "ANSI/IEEE C63.4"
    accept "ANSI Std A119.1"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
